senses.gloss: (v. שׁוּף II, a. שָׁפָה I) to crush, rub.—Part. pass. שָׁפוּף; f. שְׁפוּפָה; pl. שְׁפוּפִים, שְׁפוּפִין; שְׁפוּפוֹת

units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 65:17">Gen. R. s. 65</cite> <he>היו רגליהם ש׳ בארץ</he> their feet (which were hanging down) rubbed against the ground; (Y. Peah VII, 20ᵇ top <he>נוגעות</he>).—
senses.label: a

units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22">Gen. R. s. 22</cite> the evil inclination <he>דומה ללסטיס ש׳ וכ׳</he> is like an enfeebled robber sitting on the cross-road &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 36">Yalk. ib. 36</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 840">Yalk. Ps. 840</cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 25:3">Gen. R. s. 25</cite>, end <he>בני אדם ש׳</he> weak people, opp. <he>גבורים</he>; <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah, Petichta 1">Ruth R. to I, 1</cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 53">Gen. R. s. 53</cite> <he>עכשיו … לא ש׳ וכ׳</he> now what is his gift (the child born to him)? is it not puny? I put my finger &c. (v. <cite ref="Q00485"><he>פְּחַשׁ</he></cite>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 810:1">Yalk. Deut. 810</cite> <he>מתנתיה … שְׁפִיפָה</he> (Chald.).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 60">Gen. R. s. 60</cite> <he>דווין וש׳</he> ed., v. <cite ref="U01734"><he>שָׁפָה</he> I</cite>; a. fr.
senses.label: b

senses.gloss: to rub, polish, brush off. Y. Sabb. IV, end, 7ᵃ עד שיְשַׁפְשֵׁף until he rubs (the stones, to wipe off the dirt); Bab.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 125b:8">Sabb. 125ᵇ</cite> <he>צאו ושׁפְשְׁפוּם</he> go out and rub them. Y. Ter. I, beg. 40ᵃ <he>במְשַׁפְשֵׁף בהן במים</he> when he scours them with water.
<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 9:2">Mikv. IX, 2</cite> <he>אלא אם כן ש׳</he> unless he has rubbed the soot off.

<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 1:18">Tosef. Dem. I, 18</cite> <he>משפשף</he> he may rub him (with oil). Y. Ber. IX, 14ᶜ top <he>עד ששִׁיפְשֵׁף</he> before rubbing (the rectum), v. <cite ref="M02934"><he>מִשְׁמֵשׁ</he></cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 28b:13">B. Kam. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>ונשוף באבן</he> (Ms. F. <he>ונושף</he> read: <he>ונישף</he>), v. <cite ref="U00490"><he>שׁוּף</he> II</cite>.
